name: @ryntra/api-client
description: Typed client for the Ryntra API v1 native contract: capabilities, Sign In With Solana into a bearer session, the proven wallet's watchlist; since 1.1.0 the Trading Plan, its Review block, its execution binding and the device registry as types; since 1.5.0 the evidence observation a plan's conditions are judged on, with the registry of what a condition may name; since 1.8.0 Ryntra, the AI assistant — the proven wallet's conversation, its structured answers, cards, drafts and budget; since 1.9.0 Results beyond the entry — an operation as an entry or an exit, the cost parts kept apart, an exit judged only by rules that existed before it, the plans that made no trade, the positions, and a strategy memory whose every fact cites its record. Since 1.11.0 the routes the clients already consume outside /api/v1 — the markets, the stocks, the holdings, the activity, the receipt archive, the rewards, the monitoring, the predictions and the swap — typed as they are served, with read methods that throw RyntraRouteError, and the Telegram channel over the bearer. Since 1.20.0 «Перевірка» — the four lines and the reserve the server counts for a purchase or a sale of a company, on the swap's quote and order — and «Популярне», the companies by the day's trading. Since 1.21.0 Нагляд over the wallet's company positions — each with its exit, its state and its one action, decided by the server — and «Ryntra попередить» turned on with a preset. Since 1.22.0 «Гроші» — payment links made, listed and read, a Ryntra link paid through its own routes, the recipient check before a transfer, Send on the transfer routes with «Перевірка» counted by the server and the reading of what the wallet returned. Since 1.23.0 «Ризик портфеля» — one word for the wallet as a whole, with every rule broken or what could not be read, decided by the server. Since 1.24.0 fee policy v2 — a swap's Ryntra fee by its flow, and the /build lane whose fee is paid whole into Ryntra's fee wallet. Since 1.25.0 Ryntra Launch — the presets, the token's metadata, the first purchase under its cap, the creation and the creator's lock to sign, the submit and the token's read with its launch receipt — served where capabilities.launch is present. Since 1.26.0 the Rewards rank — the rank by points over 30 days, the share a friend's trade pays at it, and the ladder. Since 1.27.0 a launch's market — the price and market cap, the curve's way to the DEX, the holders with their labels, the trades, the chart, the facts of risk and the creator's other launches — and buying and selling it on its curve or in its pool. Since 1.28.0 the Rewards badges — every rank the wallet has reached and when, and its achievements. Since 1.29.0 the creator's cabinet — a wallet's launches, what each earned it by source, «Забрати» with its receipt, the creator earnings card — and «Спільнота» sharing the creator's fees. Since 1.30.0 Ryntra Launch on mainnet for people, its writes behind Launch's own operator stop. Since 1.31.0 a recurring-buy rule on any token with liquidity — a company, a coin, a meme or a new token on the floor — with the token's standing read before a rule is written, a token's price condition against its price when the rule was turned on, and the floor judged at every reminder. Since 1.32.0 a launch's flight log — every act on the token with its time, amount and transaction, the creator's sales, the graduation and who sent it — and the Fee-Funded Liquidity Ladder on a graduated launch as it stands. Since 1.33.0 a holder's position in a graduated launch's pool — one coin in through Meteora's Zap, the permission Ryntra's collector asks for (the fees paid only to the owner), «Увімкнути» and «Відкликати», «Мої позиції» with the holder's earnings card. Since 1.34.0 a launch's trades in the activity with their own origin, Ryntra's part of the fee and an Outcome Receipt read by the wallet and the signature, and the link to share a trade. Since 1.35.0 the referral that binds on its own — the window to add an inviter or to change it once, and the refusal ALREADY_CHANGED. Since 1.36.0 the markets launched on Ryntra — a row each with the state of its cycle, the curve's way to the DEX, the pool's liquidity, the market's budget, depth at −5 %, days since the DEX, holders and the creator — one market's card with its addresses, its health by fixed definitions (depth at −2/−5/−10 %, budget, survival, holders, the creator, concentration, Ryntra's executor, the rules and policies that keep it), and the flight log, each entry marked rule or policy; public, no wallet. Since 1.37.0 the flight log's marks — the executor's first pass over a market, the states of its cycle as the executor read them, the operator's stop and resume of the executor, a failed graduation it sends again — and the operator's stop as a market's pause. Since 1.38.0 Micro — a small market for people at 750 USDC, its whole migration fee to the market's budget, the creator's first buy always locked — and the demo market Ryntra uses for its own technical validation. Since 1.39.0 a market's budget from its fees — on Micro and the demo market the executor claims the partner fees of the markets Ryntra launched itself, the budget by source with Ryntra's revenue apart, what waits in Meteora's pools on people's markets, the claims in the flight log and the budget's risk limits as a pause. Since 1.40.0 the creator's purchases after the launch in the flight log, as the sales already were. Since 1.41.0 a holder's entry for people behind its switch — the owner's closed fee accounts and every claim's count on a position, and `open` the same for every address named. Since 1.42.0 a note's subject may be a spot limit order — «Ордер виконано» and «Квитанція готова». Since 1.43.0 the assistant's conversations listed with their dates and a 90 days' retention, «Нова розмова» (`fresh`), and a guest's market question without a wallet. Since 1.44.0 a token's news from Ryntra's allow-listed feeds as a card, and «What moved the price?» with every line marked fact, unverified, inference or unknown. Since 1.45.0 the Rewards programme of rules 2.1.0 — the wallet's claim floor by its USDC account, «First $10 back» and its window, and the inviter's 90 days. Since 1.46.0 «Ранковий огляд» — the proven wallet's morning brief at its own time: «Сьогодні на ринку» for everyone and its own changes, each line marked fact or unverified, and a note of kind assistant-brief. Since 1.47.0 a market's health says when whether Ryntra's executor acts was not read. Since 1.48.0 the prediction link's start under load — CHALLENGE_REQUIRED with the bot check's site key, the start again with its token, CHALLENGE_FAILED when that token is refused. Since 1.49.0 a launch's figures for its creator — what the creator's side earned over the day and the week by source, the volume, the holders, the traders and those who came back, the liquidity, after the DEX the depth ±2 % and the pool's fees, the creator's own trades and lock — the creator's public profile, and a note of kind launch-creator. Since 1.50.0 a pool trade's fee with the liquidity's part split between the creator's and Ryntra's locked positions, the other liquidity and the compounding share; the presets' terms; the launch's partner before the signature; LAUNCH_BUSY when too many launches go out this hour. Since 1.52.0 the assistant's credits — the day's free credits, the balance, every action's price shown before the question (`acceptCredits`), the credits' history and the welcome credits once per wallet and account. Since 1.53.0 a market list says `stale` only when its oldest read behind the rows shown is older than five minutes or held after a failed refresh, and then names that read's time as `lastGoodAt`. Since 1.54.0 buying credits for USDC — the packages, an order paid to Ryntra's treasury on its payment page with its own reference, credited once from the chain, the receipts. Since 1.57.0 «Стежити за токеном» — the proven wallet's token watches (a price level, a move over 5 min, 1 h or 24 h, a volume spike, a change of liquidity), presets, three free, pause, change and remove, and a note of kind token-watch. Since 1.61.0 «План угоди й критик» — a trade plan the strong model composes with the person from their idea, their loss limit and any level they know: the thesis, the entry and its bound, the invalidation, up to three targets, the fees and the size, every assumption with who made it, the sources; the critic under its own instruction beside the plan engine's checks; versions, states from a draft to broken, approval into the person's own Trading Plan watched by Нагляд, and «План проти реальності» with each trade's receipt and risk in words. Since 1.66.0 «Перевірено Seeker» — whether the proven wallet holds a Seeker Genesis Token, read by the server on mainnet. Since 1.90.0 prepared actions — an agent, a chat or a partner prepares a swap for a person to sign in their own wallet: made and read with no bearer, the intent's frozen fields under a digest, Ryntra's own https link and a QR. No runtime dependency beyond fetch. Since 1.55.0 the survival of the markets launched on Ryntra at 7, 30 and 90 days, each market that lived proven by a trade's transaction, and a token's metadata and picture with their IPFS address and pinned copy. Since 1.56.0 «Формати запуску 2» — «Спільнота»'s community tokens, «Розширений» with its own config inside the network's bounds, Launch Boost with its budget locked from the creator to the creator and its payout signed by the creator, and early access on Meteora (an honest Token-2022 mint, a DAMM v2 pool with a position locked for ever, an Alpha Vault), each format null where it is not offered. Since 1.58.0 «Знайомство» — the proven wallet's answers to the assistant's five questions (goal, experience, risk per trade, horizon) or that they were skipped, with where notes go; they shape only how Ryntra words an answer. Since 1.60.0 the cashback each trade earned, by its signature, beside the activity's rewards. Since 1.62.0 the prediction failure codes FUNDING_OFF and WITHDRAWAL_OPEN (the funding routes). Since 1.63.0 a note of kind wallet-watch — a trade of a wallet the person follows. Since 1.64.0 voice heard on the server — a recording for the question field at the price shown, the words back for the person to correct, never a question asked. Since 1.65.0 a Seeker owner's .skr name — a name to the address that owns it now, never cached, and an address to the name its wallet chose. Since 1.67.0 the capability and authority matrix — every venue × action on Solana with its honest state (LIVE, PAPER, PREVIEW, DISABLED, UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN, RECOVERY), who may act, who holds the bound and whether it runs by itself. Since 1.68.0 «Події ринку» — one public feed of market events (a new token, a token out to a DEX, an Alpha Vault, a liquidity change, a right still on, a creator's lock opening, a creator's sale, a launch's flight log), each with its source, its time, its transaction and its finality. Since 1.69.0 the creator's division of their own share — собі · глибина · спільнота · холдерам — its rule and lines, what it owes and what was done, the depth steps and the payout rounds with their roots. Since 1.70.0 the curve's surplus as a fourth source of a launch's creator fees in the creator's cabinet and its claim receipts. Since 1.72.0 «Комісія за переказ» — a «Розширений» token may take a fee on transfers until the DEX (RevokeZeroFee, the creator collects), its cycle and timeline read from the chain and the creator's harvest and withdraw. Since 1.71.0 a safe launch — on Micro and the demo market a first purchase and its lock in one v1 transaction (`format: v1`), a token's picture checked before it is stored, and a token Ryntra took down read without its picture, description and links. Since 1.73.0 «Забрати все» — the Review before a creator's claim: every pocket of the creator's side with what it holds and whether the claim takes it, the transactions the wallet signs and what each takes, the exit position as an NFT and who holds it, the surplus as Meteora splits it — and a pair currency's watch on a launch's read, with LAUNCH_QUOTE_PAUSED when its issuer changed the token's rules. Since 1.74.0 launch windows and crews — the windows' published schedule, a crew invited by X handle with each member's own yes, its members as the Dynamic Fee Sharing vault's rows at liftoff, and the crews in flight. Since 1.75.0 a team's roles and rights — teams of wallets with nine roles and a matrix of rights checked on the server, a high-risk right only as a proposal on the team's Squads treasury, one wallet in many teams, and the server's check for one right. Since 1.76.0 the Perps markets' state, group, names and funding schedule, the funding rate now and the ticket's margin by Phoenix's SDK (routes outside /api/v1). Since 1.78.0 a payment link counts only money that arrived in its token, summed over every payment, and says what arrived and what a transfer fee withheld. Since 1.80.0 «Правила на кривій» — the four Token-2022 transfer-hook rules Ryntra allows on a launch's curve with their bounds, the rules that lock a buyer in refused by name, the rules read from a launch's mint until the DEX in place of «no rule on transfers», and the audited rule program with who may change it; offered nowhere until an independent security audit of that program and an explicit decision open it. Since 1.82.0 a wallet's own Perps history — its fills, its orders and its funding settlements from Phoenix's public reads (a route outside /api/v1). Since 1.84.0 a distribution campaign — a vesting or airdrop campaign whose list and root are published on Met Lock's root escrow and funded with exactly what the list adds up to, its Review with every fee as its own row and which promises a program keeps, the chain read against the list, the rows held back for a person, the leftovers with whether anything can bring each one back, the campaign's report, and a wallet's own claim panel with the chain's receipt for each claim — the recipient the only signer, and a second claim of a row impossible on chain. Since 1.85.0 the risk verdict before a trade — four words over thirteen named facts, each with its source and the time it was read, on a swap's quote and order, a spot limit order's Review and a launch trade's quote; `NO_KNOWN_BLOCKER` means no known blocker and never «safe», and a fact that was not read is INCOMPLETE naming what is missing. Since 1.86.0 the developer console's refusals, so a client that meets one reads its code rather than an unknown string. Since 1.87.0 a market launched on Ryntra says when Ryntra took its picture, description and links down (`hidden`). Since 1.88.0 the pre-sign check — one unsigned transaction or payment link in, allow · warn · block out with every reason, its check, its level and its source, the simulated changes by holder, and the declared intent compared with them; no score, never «safe». Since 1.89.0 the path of a launch's flow in the capabilities — the launch slot, the bundles, the creator's strip and the buyers counted once per funding cluster (its answer is typed in @ryntra/client). No runtime dependency beyond fetch.
